hits.snippet: Enterprises spent the last year handing AI agents the keys to their databases, internal tools, and customer systems. Almost none of them can tell you what those agents actually did, or what it cost them. We led FriskAI's $3.6M pre-seed because Neel Palrecha is solving the unglamorous problem that has to get solved first: a plain, readable record of every action an agent takes, down to the tokens it burned getting there. That second part matters more than people realize. When an agent decides its own path, spend stops being a line item you can forecast and becomes something you discover at the end of the month. Teams need to see where tokens go, which workflows are quietly expensive, and what scaling to 10x volume actually costs before they commit to it. [...] 17,258 followers As AI agents move from experimentation into real-world enterprise workflows, visibility and trust become critical. We’re excited to lead the $3.6M pre-seed round in FriskAI, which is building the runtime intelligence layer enterprises need to understand what AI agents are actually doing once deployed.
